description: Line-range masks selecting the C++ implementation sections modeled by lean/disaster-recovery. Mapped files default to fully included (include/ccf/service/tables/self_healing_open.h is included whole without a mask); listed ranges exclude only RDP_TRACE instrumentation (and AdvanceTrace), wall-clock failover timer scheduling with cURL self-HTTP dispatch (start_failover_timers), and cURL HTTP/TLS message transport (dispatch_authenticated_message). All endpoint admission guards, quote/certificate pinning checks, /timeout primary-certificate authentication, retry phase dispatch, and message builders remain included.

exclude.reason: RDP_TRACE environment check, thread-local batch/version state, and trace_safely helper are unmodeled trace instrumentation
emit_trace, record_trace_send, prepare_trace_step, and trace_committed_step are unmodeled RDP_TRACE instrumentation
RDP_TRACE start-event emission inside try_start global hook is unmodeled trace instrumentation
RDP_TRACE retry batch/pre_version recording inside start_message_retry_timers is unmodeled trace instrumentation
Wall-clock periodic failover timer scheduling and cURL self-HTTP timeout delivery are abstracted as Input.timeout in DisasterRecovery/Model.lean
cURL HTTP/TLS client transport and record_trace_send are abstracted away by CCF.MultiNodeTransitionSystem
